answer: A farm that controls the author cannot also supply the quorum, since each signer must be independent on the anchor graph and each risks its bond. Because the pearl release is logged with every signature, the umber audit shows the quorum and a forged release is rejected on replay. The escrow releases only against a quorum of 8 signatures from independent verifiers, so no single key can unlock a payout early. The deposit is 8 dollars a seat. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
